claims.text: Pura Batu Mejan, a centuries-old sea temple set on black rock, is by Canggu Beach near the resort.

findings.quote: emitting from Pura Batu Mejan, a centuries old sea temple set on rock as black as jet
findings.note: temple on black rock heard from Canggu Beach

claims.text: The architecture firm WATG combined Balinese hallmarks with clean, contemporary silhouettes.

findings.quote: Architecturally, WATG have sensitively married Balinese hallmarks with clean, contemporary silhouettes

claims.text: The furniture is bespoke and was made by the owner in Surabaya.

findings.quote: The furniture, all bespoke and manufactured by the owner in Surabaya

claims.text: Accommodation includes suites with direct lagoon access, two-bedroom penthouses and villas with private pools.

findings.quote: direct lagoon-access, as well as a variety of suites, two-bedroom penthouses and expansive villas with private pools
especially the ground-floor ones with direct lagoon access from their terrace

claims.text: Room bookings include unlimited basic laundry service.

findings.quote: All day breakfast, 1 time complimentary Refreshment Gallery including alcoholic beverages and unlimited basic laundry service.

claims.text: Regent Club access is included for villa and penthouse guests and available as an add-on for suite bookings.

findings.quote: is only included for villa and penthouse guests but is available as an add-on to suite bookings

claims.text: The Regent Club offers all-day dining, premium wines and spirits, afternoon tea and evening cocktails with champagne.

findings.quote: Guests enjoy refined all-day culinary offerings and a carefully curated selection of premium wines and spirits, accompanied by afternoon tea rituals and evening cocktails served with champagne.

claims.text: Taru, the resort's signature restaurant, serves reinvented Indonesian dishes with modern techniques alongside international specialties.

findings.quote: The signature culinary destination of the resort, Taru offers an immersive dining experience, through reinvented authentic flavours of essential Indonesian dishes, innovated by touches of modern cooking techniques and ingredients
balanced with contrasting international specialties

claims.text: Sazón is a Mediterranean restaurant on Batu Bolong led by Chef Andrew Walsh.

findings.quote: Led by award-winning Chef Andrew Walsh, experience the neighborhood Mediterranean hideaway on Batu Bolong

claims.text: CURE bali serves a laidback take on European dining shaped by Asian flavours, by the Canggu coast.

findings.quote: A laidback take on European dining, gently shaped by Asian flavours. Set by the Canggu coast

claims.text: The Beach House has a pool and focuses on craft cocktails and seafood.

findings.quote: the Beach House lures with its shimmering pool, and ocean breeze. An ideal setting for craft cocktails and the delicate flavours of the sea.

claims.text: The spa's wet areas include a sauna, a vitality pool and an ice bath.

findings.quote: indulgent wet areas, including a rejuvenating sauna, a revitalising vitality pool, and an invigorating ice bath

claims.text: Every room has a solid teak bathtub carved with the masked face of the mythical Barong.

findings.quote: the bathtub, solid teakwood carved intricately with the masked face of the mythical Barong creature. Regardless of room type, all 150 accommodations have one

claims.text: The Beachfront Pool Villa has a private pool and uninterrupted ocean views, just steps from the shoreline.

findings.quote: Just steps from the shoreline, this beachfront villa pairs uninterrupted ocean views with a private 30 sqm pool

claims.text: The arrival pavilion has a seven-layer carving in Javanese paras sandstone.

findings.quote: commissioned an immense seven-layer carving in Javanese paras sandstone for the arrival pavilion

claims.text: All suites have a hidden butler's hatch behind a closet door for quiet food and drink delivery.

findings.quote: all the suites have a secret butler’s hatch behind a closet door where food and drinks can be delivered quietly, without disturbance

claims.text: The Refreshment Gallery's initial stock, including Bali gin, Scotch whisky, beer, jamu and local snacks, is free.

findings.quote: the initial stock of Bali gin and Scotch whisky, beer, soft beverages such as jamu, and locally made artisanal snacks such as Krakakoa Chocolate is gratis

claims.text: Two-Bedroom Suites are for families with children aged 10 and above.

findings.quote: For families with children aged 10 and above.

claims.text: The resort is not ADA compliant.

findings.quote: The resort is not ADA compliant
